sign_in.drop_failed: Couldn't drop the rejected sign-in for {host}: {why}
sign_in.dropped: Dropped the rejected sign-in for {host} from git's credential helper.
sign_in.saved.cached: No keyring helper is installed, so Git now keeps sign-ins in memory with its cache helper, for 15 minutes after each use (credential.helper in your global Git config). Saved the sign-in for {host}. Install git-credential-libsecret to keep sign-ins after a restart. To undo it: git config --global --unset credential.helper
sign_in.saved.helper: Saved the sign-in for {host} with Git's credential helper.
sign_in.saved.set_up: Git now saves sign-ins with {helper} (credential.helper in your global Git config). Saved the sign-in for {host}.
sign_in.saved.turned_off: Didn't save the sign-in for {host}: credential.helper is turned off.
